nondispatch_event_contract.instruction: Record separately from actual HTTP dispatches; never invent dispatch IDs.

join_rules: One distinct dispatch_id per actual HTTP dispatch/retry, including assessor dispatches.
Attach received billing independently of content parsing; unknown debit is null, never zero.
Provider request ID and sanitized statement-line ID permit owner reconciliation; retain missing IDs as missing.
Multiple dispatches may map to a consolidated invoice line only with an explicit allocation receipt; never duplicate its debit.
Reject duplicate dispatch IDs, duplicate allocated debits, nonfinite amounts, currency mismatches and conflicting joins.
Keep unassigned statement lines and unobserved dispatch debits unresolved; a run window alone does not prove attribution.
Separate provider credit debit, energy/noncredit payment, list-price estimates and CI/runtime expense.
Mark total complete only when every charged statement line and actual dispatch in the frozen run scope is reconciled.
publication_contract: Received-response USD is an observed subset, not total charged spend.
Publish reconciled provider and CI/runtime totals separately, only after complete attribution.
For each published total retain attempted and response-bearing denominators.
Preserve generator/assessor errors and retries even if no usable completion exists.
